cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a body is designated with a mandate over AI. The CNRM bill, adopted on 3 March 2026 with a remit over AI-generated content, is not shown promulgated.
cells.note: The data protection commission says AI-made voice or image copies without a legal basis are unlawful processing under Law 2008-12, a rule in force that meets question 2. The CNRM would oversee AI-generated content, but no promulgation is found, so no authority is designated yet.
